page.overview:
Who is AVIS Lady?

This AVIS Lady was a fictional unnamed woman who appeared briefly in the 1997 James Bond film Tomorrow Never Dies. He was portrayed by German actress Antje Schmidt.

This woman works at the AVIS rental car airport station in Hamburg. She greets Bond friendily when he approaches the counter to collect his new rental car, speaking German. Shortly after, Q (also dressed in AVIS clothing) takes over from her.

Pierce Brosnan had to undergo several weeks of lerning in order to perform his German lines 'Ja, mein Büro hat ein Auto reserviert' ('Yes, my bureau reserved a car'), which he says to the AVIS Lady and 'Lass dich nicht verarschen' ('Don't let her push you around', although a bit more vulgar), which he says to Carver's valet parking service.
